releaseNotes: feat: Integrate local on-device AI with Needle model
changelog: Added JNI bridge for Needle model integration with native C++ code.
Implemented NeedleCommandInterpreter for command parsing and inference.
Introduced NeedleModelManager for managing model download and status.
Updated MainActivity to initialize and close Needle engine.
Enhanced ConnectionPreferences to store Needle model enabled state.
Added UI components in AppearanceScreen for Needle model settings.
Created unit tests for NeedleCommandInterpreter functionality.
Updated ProGuard rules to keep NeedleNative class methods.
Added Arabic and English strings for Needle model settings.
Created build script for compiling Needle native engine for Android.
